provenance_note: Replay revision association confirmed by parent user; source SHA records code inspected during audit, not an embedded replay build manifest. Frozen replay hash identifies exact assessed outputs.
prior_audit_status: Superseded for output assessment. Original visual labels remain reusable; old output positions and correct counts are not current-version evidence.
selection: new valid AND NOT baseline valid; loss selection baseline valid AND NOT new valid
method: Sequentially decoded full original video, exported 22 additional/lost frames; inspected all clean contact rows and 3x shallow-cap zoom. Reused 29 prior gained visual labels and 3 dense labels; independently read 13 newly gained centers. Every gain compared anew against frozen 151 output. Loss6 visually checked including dense frame885.
limitations: Same implementation source video; not new independent footage or human ground truth.
Only gain45 and loss6 assessed here; does not exhaustively revalidate all unchanged valid frames.
Approximate +/-6 pixel visual tolerance, not empirical calibration accuracy.
No label values derived from detector outputs.
Synthetic negative sweep success is limited to the stated grid, not proof of no false positives.
